description: A work-in-progress matching decompilation of the original Ratchet & Clank (2002) for PlayStation 2 (SCES_509.16, PAL v2.00). Focuses on reconstructing clean, idiomatic C/C++ source code identical to the retail executable, paving the way for native PC re-implementation and game preservation.
